title: How To Search For Sub Account Members In The Database | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How To Search For Sub Account Members In The Database Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000060081 To see the list of members who have been added as a sub account, Navigate to Developers --> MySQL Database : Click on the database that ends with wording " directory ": Conduct a search for the table users_data and open it by clicking on it: Click on SQL : Paste the specified SQL code and click Go : This is the SQL code needed to run: SELECT * FROM `users_data` WHERE parent_id > 0 Which will display your members that are added as sub accounts: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
